findings.title: Staples repricing faster than any sector
findings.body: Consumer Staples' forward P/E jumped 76 percentile points in one month, to the 88th percentile, with the forward multiple at 21.25. That kind of monthly repricing is extreme and signals a violent rotation into defensives, not a gradual drift.

findings.title: Materials trapped between two realities
findings.body: Materials sits at the 27th percentile on forward earnings but the 86th on trailing, a 60-point gap with implied growth of 117 percent. The market is either pricing a massive earnings rebound or deeply distrusting current reported profits, and those two views are far apart.

findings.title: Information Technology at five-year low
findings.body: Information Technology's forward P/E of 17.31 sits at the 0th percentile of its own five-year range, cheaper than it has been at any point in that window. The trailing lens is at the 17th percentile, so the cheapness is not a trailing earnings illusion — the market is simply discounting the sector hard.
